card.name: Words that frame a span of time
card.fires_on: Words in trend passages that point to a stretch of time over which something changed, such as "same" in "during the same period", "during", or "-fold" before a date range. Mostly general web text on economics, environment and statistics.

modes.label: "same" before period
modes.description: The word "same" in "during the same period" when comparing two trends.

modes.label: Change words before a date range
modes.description: Words such as "-fold", "decrease", "has" or "changed" that are followed by a span of years.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning "since" or "in recent years" and away from "currently" or "current".
card.plain: It marks spots in a trend description where the text is about to say how much something changed over a stretch of time.
